node.title: PMA sigma-one first-layout domination
node.statement: Order the paired cores of a fixed official sigma-one word. Universal non-planted carriage implies that every Post codeword first carried after the first core is one of the first layout's M planted anchors. Hence #Post<=#E_C1+M. Evaluating the proved d<=2, (d,r)=(3,1), and full-petal (3,0) payments only in that first layout gives #Post<=B_paid+M+#R_first, with B_paid+M<n^6/1023 on every official row. Thus the finite paired-core multiplier is eliminated; it remains to pay the one-layout residual R_first within B_post-B_paid-M.
